name: SAP SE
businessSummary: Enterprise resource planning and business applications (S/4HANA Cloud, Business Technology Platform, SuccessFactors, Ariba, Concur). Cloud now the large majority of revenue; 113,076 FTE at 2026-09-30.

TTM approx EUR 11,480m. Provider EV/EBIT 21.04 (ADR). On IFRS operating profit the multiple is slightly higher.

evEbitForward.note: Guidance midpoint at constant currencies, not consensus.

netDebtToEbitda.note: About 0.1x or less; stock-agent shows -0.03x (net cash). Effectively unlevered.

interestCoverage.note: unavailable as a clean figure. Finance costs 9M 2026 EUR 902m vs non-IFRS operating profit 8,639m (about 9.6x) but SAP carries large financial income; not an EBIT/interest ratio from the provider.

sectorMetrics.note: Current cloud backlog EUR 24,144m, +28% reported / +26% constant currency (FY2025: EUR 21.05bn, +25% cc; Q4 2025 growth had slowed to 16% reported). Cloud revenue Q3 +26% cc-ish; cloud gross margin non-IFRS 74.3% vs 75.1% (-0.8pp). Cloud and software revenue Q3 EUR 9,249m (+15%); total revenue EUR 10,270m (+13%). IFRS operating profit Q3 EUR 2,930m (+18%) vs non-IFRS 3,030m (+18%); 9M 8,313m vs 8,639m (+14% each). EPS 9M: IFRS 5.50 (+17%), non-IFRS 5.20 (+15%). 9M FCF EUR 7,968m (+11%). Buyback up to EUR 10bn to end-2027, ~EUR 4.2bn done (avg EUR 164.79).

history.source: Revenue EUR 36.8bn (rallies.ai, 2026-01-29), non-IFRS operating profit EUR 10.42bn and FCF EUR 8.24bn as quoted in Q3 2026 outlook comparatives. EBIT = NON-IFRS operating profit. Margin derived and approximate (revenue rounded). EPS not retrieved.

consensus.source: stock-agent /decisions 2026-11-12 23:05:18 (https://stock-agent.manp-dev.workers.dev/decisions?horizon=long) (buy = 6 strong buy + 18 buy; counts sum to 29 vs 27 analysts, provider inconsistency)

forwardEstimates.source: unavailable; company 2026 outlook (Q3 2026): non-IFRS operating profit EUR 11.8-12.2bn cc (+13-17%), cloud revenue toward upper end of EUR 25.8-26.2bn (+23-25% cc), cloud and software revenue toward upper end of EUR 36.3-36.8bn, FCF ~EUR 10bn, current cloud backlog growth slightly decelerating from 25%, total revenue growth similar to 2025's 10.6%, non-IFRS tax ~29%.

recentEvents: 2026-10-21 Q3 2026: revenue EUR 10.27bn (+13%), non-IFRS operating profit EUR 3.03bn (+18%), current cloud backlog +28% reported (+26% cc); cloud and software revenue outlook raised to upper end; operating profit and FCF outlook unchanged.
2026-01-29: Q4 2025 report; backlog growth slowed to 16% (25% cc) and 2026 backlog guide cut to 23-25%; shares fell >16% in a day, the largest since 2020; EUR 10bn buyback announced.
Early 2026: software sell-off on AI-disruption fears; 52-week low EUR 127.50.
valueTrapFlags: Cloud gross margin compressing (non-IFRS 74.3% vs 75.1% Q3 y/y; cost of cloud +29% IFRS vs cloud revenue +26%).
Current cloud backlog growth guided to decelerate slightly; large transformation deals have longer ramp-up and termination clauses (Jan 2026 explanation).
Share price has rebounded ~67% from the low and sits near the 52w high (219.65), at ~30x trailing and ~25x forward P/E; limited valuation cushion vs the AI narrative.
No estimate cuts after the latest report: operating profit outlook unchanged, revenue outlook raised toward upper end.

FY2025 EPS and FY2025 dividend not verified.
Net debt is derived; lease treatment and other financial assets unresolved.
TTM figures partly back-solved from reported growth rates.
Historical multiples and forward EPS unavailable.

valuation.method: Next-12m non-IFRS EPS x justified P/E. Basis 2026E non-IFRS EPS 8.0 (trailing P/E 30.5 implies about 7.0; guided non-IFRS operating profit +13-17%; lead estimate). Historical multiple ranges not verified by agents; justified multiples are lead estimates.

bear.note: Cloud growth slows, AI pressure on application software multiples. Justified multiple 20x on next-12m 8.64.

base.note: Current cloud backlog +26% cc converts; margins expand. Justified multiple 26x on next-12m 9.12.

bull.note: Business AI monetises, margins beat targets. Justified multiple 30x on next-12m 9.36.

valuation.whyItFits: Mission-critical ERP with rising recurring cloud revenue: current cloud backlog +26% cc, non-IFRS operating profit +18% in Q3, net debt about zero, beta 0.7.
valuation.growthDrivers: S/4HANA cloud migrations (RISE), Business AI, operating leverage; cloud revenue outlook raised in Q3.
valuation.saturation: Near its 52-week high (EUR 219.65) after a JPM upgrade; trailing P/E 30, forward about 25: growth largely priced.
valuation.principalRisk: AI agents reducing the value of application seats; cloud gross margin slipped 0.8pp.
